accountIdentifier.description: specify the account this order will be deducted from

campaign.description: Optional. Campaign that may be used to administratively categorize a specific order. Must be between 0 and 1024 characters in length.

customerIdentifier.description: specify the customer associated with the order. Must be the customer the accountIdentifier is associated with.
customerIdentifier.title: Customer Identifier

amount.description: specify the face value of of the reward. Always required, including for fixed value items.

bulkShipping.description: Only used for and is required when deliveryMethod is BULKSHIPMENT

address.description: The address where the bulk shipment is to be delivered.

city.description: 35 characters max, Required, not blank, Digits 0-9, alpha (a-z, A-Z), space, period, hyphen, ampersand, and apostrophe.

country.description: 2 characters, Enter the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code
country.title: Country Code

postalCode.description: Allows 5 characters, not blank, Digits 0-9 and alpha (a-z, A-Z). For US addresses, this must include only the five-digit US ZIP Code.

streetLine1.description: 35 characters max, required, not blank, Digits 0-9, alpha (a-z, A-Z), space, period, comma, hyphen, forward slash (/), ampersand, percent, pound (#), at (@), and apostrophe.
streetLine1.title: Street Line 1

streetLine2.description: 35 characters max, Optional,  Not blank, Digits 0-9, alpha (a-z, A-Z), space, period, comma, hyphen, forward slash (/), ampersand, percent, pound (#), at (@), and apostrophe.
streetLine2.title: Street Line 2

deliveryMethod.title: Delivery Method

lineItemNote.description: Optional line item notes (up to 150 characters)

ptid.description: Only required for Printed Reward Links, the unique identifier for the Printed Reward Link Template provided in the Tango Portal on the Printed Template page.
ptid.title: Physical Delivery Template Identifier

quantity.description: The number of rewards to send to the recipient
quantity.title: Rewards quantity

recipient.description: Required if deliveryMethod is EMAIL, PHONE, or ADDRESS. Use to set and store the recipient’s contact information. When deliveryMethod is NONE or EMBEDDED, setting these parameters will allow the platform to store this information for reporting, auditing, and reconciliation.

address.description: Required if deliveryMethod is ADDRESS. May be required for some UTIDs. This field is optional for digital orders, NOTE: Some digital cash options may require including an address.

city.description: Required if deliveryMethod is ADDRESS, not applicable for digital rewards. Allows 30 characters, not blank, Digits 0-9, alpha (a-z, A-Z), space, period, hyphen, ampersand, and apostrophe.
city.title: City

companyName.description: Optional, Typically used when shipping to a corporate address.
companyName.title: Company Name

country.description: Required if deliveryMethod is ADDRESS, not applicable for digital rewards.
country.title: Country Code

postalCode.description: Required if deliveryMethod is ADDRESS, not applicable for digital rewards. Allows 5 characters, not blank, Digits 0-9 and alpha (a-z, A-Z). For US addresses this must include the five digit US ZIP Code only.
postalCode.title: Postal Code

stateOrProvince.description: Required if deliveryMethod is ADDRESS, not applicable for digital rewards. Address region must be a valid 2-character uppercase abbreviation for a U.S. state, territory, or military base; a Canadian province; or contain an international region less than 36 characters.
stateOrProvince.title: State or Province

streetLine1.description: Required if deliveryMethod is ADDRESS, not applicable for digital rewards. Allows 35 characters max, not blank, Digits 0-9, alpha (a-z, A-Z), space, period, comma, hyphen, forward slash (/), ampersand, percent, pound (#), at (@), and apostrophe.
streetLine1.title: Street Line 1

streetLine2.description: Optional if deliveryMethod is ADDRESS, not applicable for digital rewards. Allows 35 characters max, not blank, Digits 0-9, alpha (a-z, A-Z), space, period, comma, hyphen, forward slash (/), ampersand, percent, pound (#), at (@), and apostrophe.
streetLine2.title: Street Line 2

address.title: Recipient Address

email.description: Required if deliveryMethod is EMAIL. May be required for some UTIDs.  It is useful to include when deliveryMethod is PHONE to easily switch between email and phone delivery
email.title: Email

firstName.description: Required if deliveryMethod is EMAIL, PHONE, or ADDRESS. May be required for some UTIDs. Digital rewards: allows 100 characters, cannot use < or > or / in the name. Physical rewards: allows 25 characters max, Digits 0-9, alpha (a-z, A-Z), space period, comma, ampersand, and hyphen.
firstName.title: First Name

lastName.description: Required if deliveryMethod is ADDRESS, otherwise optional. May be required for some UTIDs. Digital rewards: allows 100 characters, cannot use < or > or / in the name. Physical rewards: allows 25 characters max, Digits 0-9, alpha (a-z, A-Z), space period, comma, ampersand, and hyphen.
lastName.title: Last Name

mobileNumber.description: Required if deliveryMethod is PHONE. May be required for some UTIDs. Format: +CCCPPPPPPPPPPPP (where C is the country code, 1-3 digits, and P is the phone number, up to 12 digits). Follows ITU E.164, allowing (+) and up to 15 digits for the combined country code and phone number.
mobileNumber.title: Mobile Number

recipient.title: Recipient Details

shippingMethod.description: Enumeration for the selected shipping method. Required for deliveryMethod of ADDRESS or BULKSHIPMENT.
shippingMethod.title: Shipping Method

utid.description: the unique identifier for the reward you are sending as provided in the Get Catalog call
utid.title: Unique Tango Card Identifier

notes.description: Optional order notes. Must be between 0 and 1024 characters in length.
notes.title: Notes

sender.description: Optional.  Use to set the sender’s name and email address if different than the default platform setting.
